en.headline: Police seize HK$3.6m etomidate and 10 replica guns in Tai Po
en.dek: A 26-year-old British national and two local men were arrested after officers found powders, vape pods and imitation firearms in a village house and car park.
body: Police said Sham Shui Po officers acting on intelligence arrested three men in Tai Po on Thursday evening after discovering a large quantity of suspected etomidate and ten imitation air guns.

Officers stopped a 26-year-old British national holding a Hong Kong identity card in a car park on San Wa On Lane and found about 512 grams of suspected etomidate powder on him. A subsequent search of a village house he rented in Ying Pun Ha Tsuen yielded a further 880 grams of the drug, 560 suspected etomidate vape pods, manufacturing tools and the ten replica guns. The total street value of the drugs was put at about HK$3.6 million.

The British man and two local men aged 29 and 35 were arrested on suspicion of trafficking in a dangerous drug, manufacturing a dangerous drug and possession of imitation firearms. They were being detained for inquiries by the Sham Shui Po District Crime Squad.
Police reminded the public that trafficking in dangerous drugs carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.

zh.headline: 大埔破毒品倉檢360萬元依托咪酯及10支仿製氣槍 3男被捕
zh.dek: 深水埗警區人員周四晚在大埔截查一名英籍男子，其後在村屋搜出大量依托咪酯、煙彈、製毒工具及仿製氣槍。
body: 警方表示，深水埗警區特別職務隊根據情報，周四晚上約7時在大埔展開打擊毒品行動。人員於新華安里一停車場截查一名持香港身份證的26歲英國籍男子，在其身上檢獲約512克懷疑依托咪酯粉末。
其後搜查該男子在營盤下村租用的木屋，在屋內外再檢獲880克懷疑依托咪酯、560粒懷疑依托咪酯煙彈、一批懷疑製毒工具及十枝懷疑仿製氣槍。行動中檢獲的毒品總市值約360萬元。
該名26歲英籍男子，以及兩名分別29歲及35歲的本地男子，均涉嫌販運危險藥物、製造危險藥物及管有仿製火器被捕，現正被扣留調查。案件交由深水埗警區重案組第二隊跟進。
警方重申，根據《危險藥物條例》，任何人如販運危險藥物，一經定罪，最高可被判處罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
